children: may test a support at $94.18 per barrel, following its failure to break a resistance at $97.95.

A wave C from $78.20 may either end around this resistance or extend to $110.16. Although the failure to climb above this barrier does not necessarily mean a completion of the wave C, the market is expected to consolidate for a few days.
The consolidation is tentatively classified as a pullback towards the upper trendline of a wedge, which indicates a target around $117.
A realistic target will be $102.62, subject to a break above $97.95. A break below $94.18 could trigger a decline to $90.41. Such a move would invalidate the bullish outlook.
On the hourly chart, a five-wave cycle from $88.90 seems to have completed around a resistance at $97.71. The market may retrace towards the bottom of the wave 4 at $93.51.
Resistance is at $96.61, a break above which may lead to a gain into the $97.10 to $97.71 range.
